title: The Anatomy of AI: A Developer’s Field Guide to the Internals
author: Syed Ahmer Shah

claims.label: verified_technical
claims.text: Decoder language models generate autoregressively, rather than producing an entire answer in one original forward pass.
claims.assessment: Use as the corrected engineering description.

claims.label: conceptual_simplification
claims.text: The article’s six-layer neural-network anatomy is a teaching diagram, not a literal description of production transformer layer counts.
claims.assessment: Useful for orientation only; do not treat it as an implementation specification.

claims.label: verified_technical
claims.text: Chain-of-thought is an inference and prompting technique that can improve some tasks; it is not a complete fact-verification system.
claims.assessment: Verification still requires evidence and deterministic checks.

claims.label: author_interpretation
claims.text: Statements about whether models possess understanding are philosophical or interpretive claims rather than settled engineering facts.
claims.assessment: Present competing interpretations and preserve uncertainty.

claims.label: conceptual_simplification
claims.text: Embeddings and latent-space geometry are useful explanatory models, while individual concepts are distributed across many activations and layers.
claims.assessment: Avoid implying a concept occupies one literal coordinate or neuron.

claims.label: requires_external_verification
claims.text: Video-generation cost rises strongly with spatial resolution, duration, frame representation, and temporal attention, but should not be called mathematically exponential without evidence.
claims.assessment: Verify the scaling claim for the specific architecture.

claims.label: time_sensitive
claims.text: Privacy policies, model names, benchmark standings, and security incidents require current retrieval before Nova states them as current facts.
claims.assessment: Do not answer from this static record as if it were live.

claims.label: requires_external_verification
claims.text: A reported Claude Code source leak may be discussed only as a security and architecture case study.
claims.assessment: Do not ingest, reproduce, execute, or depend on leaked proprietary source code.
